test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

The doctor advised me to take bed rest and eat nutritious food.

options.text: The doctor told me, "I should take bed rest and eat nutritious food."
The doctor said to me, "You take bed rest and eat nutritious food."
The doctor said to me, "Take bed rest and eat nutritious food."
The doctor said to me, "I take bed rest and eat nutritious food."

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** The doctor advised me to take bed rest and eat nutritious food.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• "The doctor advised"
